Private Function Kind(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 1
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(2, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 2
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(3, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 3
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(4, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 4
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 5
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(6, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 6
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(7, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 7
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(8, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 8
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(9, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 9
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(10, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 10
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(11, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 11
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(12, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 12
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(13, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 13
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(14, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 14
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(15, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 15
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(16, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 16
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(17, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 17
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(18, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 18
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(19, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 19
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(20, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 20
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(92, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 21
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 10, 10, 80, 40)
    Case 22
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 90, 50)
    Case 23
        Set sh = ws.ChartObjects.Add(10, 10, 200, 100).ShapeRange(1)
    Case 24
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddFormControl(xlButtonControl, 10, 10, 80, 20)
    Case 25
        Set sh = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 40, 40).Name, ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 60, 10, 40, 40).Name)).Group
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & sh.ConnectionSiteCount
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & sh.ShapeStyle
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & sh.BackgroundStyle
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & sh.GraphicStyle
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Kind = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Scaled(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, sh2 As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 100, 50, 100, 40)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        sh.ScaleWidth 1.5, msoFalse
    Case 1
        sh.ScaleWidth 1.5, msoFalse, msoScaleFromTopLeft
    Case 2
        sh.ScaleWidth 1.5, msoFalse, msoScaleFromMiddle
    Case 3
        sh.ScaleWidth 1.5, msoFalse, msoScaleFromBottomRight
    Case 4
        sh.ScaleHeight 0.5, msoFalse
    Case 5
        sh.ScaleHeight 0.5, msoFalse, msoScaleFromMiddle
    Case 6
        sh.ScaleHeight 2, msoFalse, msoScaleFromBottomRight
    Case 7
        sh.ScaleWidth 1.3333, msoFalse
    Case 8
        sh.ScaleWidth 1 / 3, msoFalse, msoScaleFromMiddle
    Case 9
        sh.ScaleWidth 1.5, msoTrue
    Case 10
        sh.ScaleWidth 0, msoFalse
    Case 11
        sh.ScaleWidth -1, msoFalse
    Case 12
        sh.ScaleWidth 5, msoFalse, msoScaleFromBottomRight
    Case 13
        sh.ScaleHeight 5, msoFalse, msoScaleFromBottomRight
    Case 14
        sh.ScaleWidth 2, msoFalse, 7
    Case 15
        sh.LockAspectRatio = msoTrue: sh.ScaleWidth 2, msoFalse
    Case 16
        sh.LockAspectRatio = msoTrue: sh.ScaleHeight 2, msoFalse, msoScaleFromMiddle
    Case 17
        sh.Rotation = 90: sh.ScaleWidth 2, msoFalse
    Case 18
        sh.Rotation = 90: sh.ScaleWidth 2, msoFalse, msoScaleFromMiddle
    Case 19
        sh.ScaleWidth 2, msoFalse: sh.ScaleWidth 2, msoTrue
    Case 20
        sh.ScaleWidth 1000, msoFalse
    Case 21
        Set sh2 = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 300, 100, 60, 30): ws.Shapes.Range(Array(sh.Name, sh2.Name)).ScaleWidth 2, msoFalse, msoScaleFromMiddle
    Case 22
        Set sh2 = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 300, 100, 60, 30): ws.Shapes.Range(Array(sh.Name, sh2.Name)).ScaleHeight 0.5, msoFalse, msoScaleFromBottomRight
    Case 23
        sh.Delete: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 100, 50, 100, 40): sh.ScaleWidth 1.5, msoFalse, msoScaleFromMiddle
    Case 24
        sh.Delete: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(100, 50, 200, 90): sh.ScaleWidth 1.5, msoFalse, msoScaleFromMiddle
    Case 25
        sh.Delete: Set sh = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 50, 100, 40).ShapeRange(1): sh.ScaleWidth 1.5, msoFalse
    End Select
    s = "ok " & sh.Left & "/" & sh.Top & "/" & sh.Width & "/" & sh.Height
    If Not sh2 Is Nothing Then s = s & "|" & sh2.Left & "/" & sh2.Top & "/" & sh2.Width & "/" & sh2.Height
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Scaled = s
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & sh.Left & "/" & sh.Top & "/" & sh.Width & "/" & sh.Height
    Resume Done
End Function

Private Function Ranged(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sr As Object, a As Object, b As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set a = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 80, 40): Set b = ws.Shapes.AddShape(9, 100, 10, 80, 40)
    ws.ChartObjects.Add 10, 100, 200, 100
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name))
    Case 1
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name))
    Case 2
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name))
    Case 3
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name))
    Case 4
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name))
    Case 5
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name))
    Case 6
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(3))
    Case 7
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(3))
    Case 8
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
    Case 9
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
    Case 10
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
    Case 11
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
    Case 12
        Set sr = ws.Shapes.Range(Array(a.Name, b.Name))
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        s = TypeName(sr.TextFrame)
    Case 1
        s = TypeName(sr.TextFrame2)
    Case 2
        s = sr.BlackWhiteMode
    Case 3
        s = sr.ConnectionSiteCount
    Case 4
        s = TypeName(sr.Chart)
    Case 5
        s = sr.ShapeStyle
    Case 6
        s = TypeName(sr.Chart)
    Case 7
        s = sr.Chart.Parent.Name
    Case 8
        s = TypeName(sr.TextFrame)
    Case 9
        s = TypeName(sr.TextFrame2)
    Case 10
        s = sr.BlackWhiteMode
    Case 11
        s = sr.ConnectionSiteCount
    Case 12
        s = TypeName(sr.Chart)
    End Select
    If Err.Number Then s = "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.Close False
    Ranged = s
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 25
        s = s & "@@@" & Kind(i)
    Next
    For i = 0 To 25
        s = s & "@@@" & Scaled(i)
    Next
    For i = 0 To 12
        s = s & "@@@" & Ranged(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
